title: helpful fact_feedback raises trust and records canonical history
description: Proves the fact_feedback tool is wired end-to-end: a `helpful` action on a seeded fact must raise its trust_score above the seeded value and append a typed result to the canonical memory_v2_feedback_history table. Guards against a regression where feedback is silently dropped or stops moving trust.
contract_notes: Deterministic write-path check with no LLM. Helpful feedback raises trust and records one available canonical history row with a typed result identity. The single seeded fact is fact_id=1 in the fresh fixture.

facts.content: Payments service exposes an idempotency key on POST /charges

assertions.name: feedback_target_fixture_loaded
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM memory_facts WHERE source = 'feedback-target'

assertions.name: helpful_feedback_raised_trust_above_seed
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM memory_facts WHERE source = 'feedback-target' AND trust_score > 0.3

assertions.name: helpful_feedback_result_recorded
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM memory_v2_feedback_history WHERE action = 'helpful' AND details_availability = 'available' AND length(result_id) > 0
